subject: Partner-led discovery: coordinate technical deep dive with CloudBridge
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery: coordinate technical deep dive with CloudBridge

Thanks again for the time today, Sofia — great conversation and I appreciate the context on CloudBridge's marketplace integration and the three priority use cases you outlined. Very excited about the potential fit.

Quick recap and proposed next steps: 
- Redwood will run a 60–90 minute technical deep dive/demo focused on integration and performance for marketplace images.
- Attendees we recommend from Redwood: Mateo (solutions engineering, runtime/ops), Camila (partner ops), myself (AM).
- Please loop in any CloudBridge engineers who will own the integration and the marketplace listing.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tuesday 18 May, 10:00–11:30
- Wednesday 19 May, 14:00–15:30
- Thursday 20 May, 09:00–10:30

I've attached a short proposed demo agenda and a one-pager on Redwood's marketplace workflow for reference. If none of the slots above work, share a couple alternatives and we'll align.

Attachments: [attachment: proposed-demo-agenda.docx] [attachment: CloudBridge-Roadmap.pdf]

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap.

We can do Wednesday 19 May, 14:00–15:30 PDT. I'll also invite Luis (luis.martinez@cloudbridge.com), our integrations lead, and Priya (priya@cloudbridge.com) from the marketplace team — they're the folks who will drive the listing and testing.

One ask from our side: can Mateo include a brief section (10–15 mins) covering the recommended runtime footprint and KV/cache implications for marketplace images? That will help our infra team prepare.

I attached a calendar invite placeholder and added a link to our internal integration checklist for prep.

Links/attachments: [attachment: CB-invite-19May.ics] [https://cloudbridge.atlassian.net/l/cp/integration-checklist]

See you then — Sofia

Perfect — Wednesday 19 May, 14:00–15:30 PDT is locked on our side.

I'll have Mateo cover runtime footprint, KV/cache behavior, and checklist items for a smooth marketplace image test (he'll keep it ~15 minutes as requested).

Calendar: I've sent a calendar invite to all attendees (placeholder shown below). Please accept and add any additional engineers. If you have a preferred test image or brief network/firewall notes ahead of the call, drop them into the Google doc (link below) so Mateo can prep.

Placeholder calendar invite: [attachment: Redwood-CloudBridge-DeepDive-19May.ics]

Prep doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abc-demo-agenda

Next steps after the call: agree on a small pilot image, share access details, and run a short smoke test in our infra (target: 2–3 business days post-demo).

Thanks — see you on Wednesday.

Best,
